lines.text: These are the main English subtitles. For added awesomeness, please click the English (Canada) subtitles. Thank you!

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: The world has been overcome by naughtiness.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: You know, I actually do celebrate Christmas.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Yeah; if you think about it, I'm basically the Son of God.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'Wait, so does that make me the Holy Spirit?'

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Um, have any of you seen the news today?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: The only thing my Dad watches on Christmas is the Rankin Bass Rudolf movie on loop.

lines.speaker: May
lines.text: May McStand here, live from West City, where a toxic miasma has the local townsfolk collapsing en masse.

lines.speaker: May
lines.text: In unrelated news, several machines have been descending from the skies via dark *ungodly* orb in the outer atmosphere.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Someone or some*thing* is trying to ruin Christmas again.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Thanks. I've been waiting for someone to try and ruin Christmas again.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Those machines are the ones expelling the gas.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: It's some kind of aerosolized coal particulates, but...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: So what? Is someone trying to kill the whole world with Miner's Lung?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: *Gasp* Be careful, Gohan! You're a minor!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh. Hey, Geets! When'd you get here?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: What's up, Dad? You're looking... uncharacteristically wistful.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Every Christmas Eve--before it was replaced by Freeza Day--I'd sit out on my porch and fire into the night sky, hoping to kill Santa.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: (gasp) Oh no! You never hit him, did you?!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I thought I did once, but it was actually just a pod carrying my brother, Tarble.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: They never found it... or the body.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: What I'm saying is it's Christmas Eve and something needs to die.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: So I'm feeling a little nostalgic.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: There it is. One of the machines that's ruining Christmas.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Then we find the Grinch that made them, and send that grimacing green monster straight to HFIL!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Who wants to blow it up?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Ha ha! And *that's* how Vegeta saved C--! rrrrrrrrap.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Want I should take a swing at it?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: It's wonderful, this time of year...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: That's right, Monkeys! We have returned for our revenge!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Is that like the royal "we", or...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Come forth, villains of Freeza Day past!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Brother, we agreed on villains of *Christmas* past.

lines.speaker: Slug
lines.text: Okay. So like, I showed up in July.

lines.speaker: Slug
lines.text: I-I'm just here for revenge. You know...more or less--

lines.speaker: Turles
lines.text: And I'm more than happy to take another crack at this nut!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Every time I look in the mirror.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And *this* is why we don't let the lower class have nice things.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: And herrrre we goooo with the politics...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: We're here to make this your last Freeza Day on Earth.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Seriously, it's always got to be about you, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Well, that is what father said.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: He also said he loved us both equally.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Well, you know how fond father was of *jokes*!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: And that's why he had you *second*, punchline!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I refuse to fight to that.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: It's something in the air, Dad! (coughs)

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: That's right, fools! Let's just say you're getting a little more than coal for Christmas.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You know, Christmas is a time where we should all come together--

lines.speaker: Turles
lines.text: You're right. So, let's all come together...
♫ Christmas In Hollis by RUN-DMC playing in Bulma's ride ♫
♫ Christmas In Hollis by RUN-DMC playing in Bulma's ride ♫

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: I ran a bunch of tests on the gas, and I discovered that it's not just coal,

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: So I took some of baby Trunks' blood and synthesized enough niceness to destroy the--

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Right? Now, I'm off to go destroy the other machines.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: I'm sorry, dear brother, but I thought it was all about *you*.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Cathartic as that was, I don't think this is over.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: That did feel more like a symptom than a cause.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hold on! Let me check with the big guy upstairs.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Merry Christmas, King Kai! Quick question: Do you know if anyone is attacking the Earth, right now?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: (t) Oh yeah! *Real suspicious-looking* mini-moon sitting around in your upper atmosphere.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: I was gonna tell you tomorrow since, you know, it's Christmas...

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Anyway, that thing is *overflowing* with naughty energy.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: So, whatever you do, be careful.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Or don't. Whatever, I'm like, 5 eggnogs in.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: I see. You have failed me, my dark ornaments.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: But... it is of no concern.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: Soon... the whole *world* will know the *true* meaning of Christmas.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: Oh, good! You're right on time!

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: Welcome to my workshop... The Star of Death-lehem!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Dad, he is the one trying to destroy Christmas.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: I'm the one with the lists here.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: I decide good and evil... and you're *all* at the top of my naughty list!

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: Piccolo, you tried to subjugate the entire planet!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Pft. Sins of the father, much?

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: Trunks, you've completely destabilized the space-time continuum, with your reckless time-travel!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: (classic TV sound) I have no idea what you're talking about. The space-time continuum is fine.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: Jesus Christ, I-- ...I mean just... wow!

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: There's not enough time in the *day*...

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: But how about we *start* with the hole you put in my sleigh?!

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: Your ceaseless lust for battle has endangered not only your family... but your *entire planet*! TIME, and time again!

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: You are a danger to the *entire universe*!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: How could *I* ever endanger the whole universe?

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: You're actually on the nice list.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh wow. Thank you so much, Santa!
(in French) Thank you very much, Father Christmas!

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: But for the rest of you, and this un-salvageable planet...

lines.speaker: Dr. Lychee
lines.text: the only present I have is--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: GOT HIM! MERRY CHRISTMAS FOR VEGETA!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Okay, so did we just... save Christmas?

lines.speaker: Hatchiyack
lines.text: Prince of the Saiyans... *Yule* regret your actions against the mighty Claus!

lines.speaker: Hatchiyack
lines.text: What you destroyed was merely a leftover shell from my... Christmas Eve-olution.

lines.speaker: Hatchiyack
lines.text: You see, Saiyans... ...you're not dealing with the average Father Christmas, anymore.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh my God, he's gone Super Santa!

lines.speaker: Hatchiyack
lines.text: And I'm a right grumpy old elf!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Eat your milk and cookies in Hell!!

lines.speaker: Hatchiyack
lines.text: You better not pout, but you're gonna die.

lines.speaker: Hatchiyack
lines.text: ♫ Santa Claus is taking you down. ♫

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Why did you just stand there?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Haha, it's the last thing he'd expect.

lines.speaker: Hatchiyack
lines.text: What child is this, who laid to rest on Santa's lap, is bleeding?!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Not really feeling the "goodwill towards men", up in here.

lines.speaker: Hatchiyack
lines.text: I'm all out of goodwill, but here's a stocking-stuffer for you!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Starting to get *real sick* of these Christmas pu--

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I'll punch your Christmas lights ou--!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'They're getting pa rum pum pum pummeled up there!'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Think, Goku. How do we save Christmas?'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Guys! I figured out his weakness!
♫ "Carol of the Bells" by Trans-Siberian Orchestra ♫

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You see, Santa? Christmas isn't about the presents...!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: It's not about the figgy pudding...!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Or the pretty lights... ...or the *obnoxiously catchy* music.

lines.speaker: Hatchiyack
lines.text: I'll crush your Christmas spirits, and then I'll send this naughty world to oblivion!!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Goku's right! Christmas is about the bonds that bring us together!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And that's the true meaning of Christmas!!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: And that's the last Christmas pun.
(explosions toward end of the world explosion)

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey Goku, Gohan, Vegeta, Piccolo, and Trunks!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Gohan, where have you two been?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: We went to go see Santa.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Huh. Guess you had to be there. Anyway, who wants eggnog?!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Honestly, this is the best Christmas I've ever had.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Damn right. A proper Saiyan Christmas!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: You know, a lot of people probably died in that smoke.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, we can wish them all back... Tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And to all, a good fight!

lines.speaker: Kaiserneko
lines.text: Hey folks! Hope you enjoyed Plan to Eradicate Christmas!

lines.speaker: Kaiserneko
lines.text: If you did, how about you take a sleigh ride over to our Discord and chat up other fans about it, and all the other projects we got going on?

lines.speaker: Kaiserneko
lines.text: You can also ask us questions in the Q&A channel, post and view fan art, and more!

lines.speaker: Kaiserneko
lines.text: Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays, and lots of love, from Team Four Star!

segments.title: Christmas Is Ho-Ho-Over
segments.quote: The world has been overcome by naughtiness. ... Christmas... is ho... ho... ...over.

segments.title: Hoping to Kill Santa
segments.quote: I'd sit out on my porch and fire into the night sky, hoping to kill Santa. / I have an uncle?? / You *had* an uncle.

segments.title: Villains of Freeza Day Past
segments.quote: How's the tree doing? / Destroyed. / And *this* is why we don't let the lower class have nice things.

segments.title: Magic Baby Blood
segments.quote: Magic baby blood. Cool. / Also, visit some African warlords. / Did-- ...did nobody shoot her?

segments.title: Santa's... Workshop?
segments.quote: SANTA!! / Dad, he is the one trying to destroy Christmas. / ...that would make him... *evil*!

segments.title: The Naughty List
segments.quote: And *you*, Vegeta... Jesus Christ, I-- ...I mean just... wow! / HA! I *did* hit him!

segments.title: Moby Dick... in French!
segments.quote: You're actually on the nice list. / Oh, it's Moby Dick... (gasp) ...in French! Merci beaucoup, Père Noël!

segments.title: MERRY CHRISTMAS FOR VEGETA
segments.quote: FINAL FLAAAAAASH!! / GOT HIM! MERRY CHRISTMAS FOR VEGETA! / Vegeta, noooo! / Vegeta, YEESS!! / (crying) We killed Santaaa!!

segments.title: Christmas Eve-olution
segments.quote: *Yule* regret your actions against the mighty Claus! / Oh my God, he's gone Super Santa!

segments.title: Yippee-Ki-Yay
segments.quote: Eat your milk and cookies in Hell!! / Yippee-ki-yay... MOTHERFUCKER!!

segments.title: Santa Claus Is Taking You Down
segments.quote: ♫ Santa Claus is taking you down. ♫ / Garland Gun...! / You what, mate? / ...Fire!!

segments.title: The True Meaning of Christmas
segments.quote: It's about friends! / And family! / And killing Santa!! / And now... he's Feliz Navi-dead.

segments.title: YES! BOXING DAY!
segments.quote: Well, we can wish them all back... Tomorrow! / YES! BOXING DAY!
